summary: Getty Images Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing that its board unanimously resolved to terminate the merger agreement with Shutterstock, Inc., after the U.K. CMA conditioned clearance on the sale of Shutterstock's editorial business. Getty Images was not required to accept that condition. Termination will occur after the Second Extended End Date on July 6, 2026, absent a material change. Following termination, Getty Images' 10.500% senior secured notes due 2030 will be redeemed under a special mandatory redemption clause. The board intends to retain a financial advisor for strategic financing alternatives. Watch for the redemption mechanics and potential new financing or alternative strategic transactions.
